description: This file defines the AccessDeniedException class within the SuiteCRM exception namespace. It extends a base Exception class and customizes the constructor to prepend a specific label to the error message.

classes.name: AccessDeniedException
classes.description: A custom exception class for access denial errors, extending a base Exception class and providing a constructor that adds a specific prefix to the message.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of AccessDeniedException with an optional message, code, and previous exception. It prefixes the message with '[AccessDeniedException]'.
